clock_domain: clk; board top connects core_clk; cmd interface is already decoded in core domain
reset: rst active-high synchronous; clears all status, identity, busy, and result state

ports.name: cmd_ready
ports.semantics: low while result byte stream is active

ports.name: error
ports.semantics: sticky, except valid descriptor/start/reset clear paths

ports.name: overflow
ports.semantics: sticky core-input overflow or external input_overflow

ports.name: result_byte
ports.semantics: 112-byte result stream, one byte per handshake

ports.name: descriptor_loaded
ports.semantics: cleared on reset; set on valid LOAD_DESCRIPTOR

notes: Does not implement PHK2 PearlHash datapath.
Command acceptance/result byte stream are coupled to board v1 decoder and are not a stable real-core boundary.
